articles.title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
articles.snippet: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.snippet: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as stocks rally following Anthropic IPO filing
articles.snippet: Alongside Anthropic raising as much as $100 billion, Meta on Monday announced a $95 billion share sale to fund its own AI ambitions.

articles.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
articles.snippet: The Mumbai-based exchange initially dismissed reports of suspicious outflows as a false alarm. It now says it lost $16 million and will absorb the loss.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
articles.snippet: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.
